observation: Pharmacy counter: the pharmacist slips a plain box into a paper bag; prescription tablet in the left foreground. Inspected at 25% (contact sheet), 100% (full panel) and 200% (face crops), and on the composed page.

anatomy.note: Left hand holds the bag open, right hand places the box; fingers read correctly.

contact.note: Box held between right fingers at the bag mouth; bag rests on the counter.

objects.note: Unlabelled medicine boxes on the shelves; tablet card shows icons and bars only, no text or drug names.

faces.note: Faces match the sheets at 200%; see faceIdentity.

linework.note: Clean contours and flat cel shading matching the other pages.

background.note: Shelves, plant and window give a pharmacy with light detail.

continuity.note: Pharmacist matches the pharmacy-lab sheet (white coat, blue shirt, moustache).

lettering.note: Four-line caption top-left and the NEW PRESCRIPTION label bottom-left over the tablet edge; clear of his face and both hands.

traits: kind hooded eyes with crow's feet
round face with a neat moustache and dimpled cheeks; greying temples as on the pharmacy-lab sheet
